<?php
class NanCvQuietRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): float { echo "GET;"; return NAN; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$reader = new NanCvQuietRead;
$selector = "";
$destination = 42;
set_error_handler(function (int $level, string $message, string $file, int $line) use (&$reader, &$selector): bool {
    echo $level === 2 ? "WARN;" : "BAD_LEVEL;";
    echo isset($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_GUARD;" : "EMPTY_GUARD;";
    $selector = "other";
    echo isset($reader->$selector) ? "OTHER;" : "BAD_OTHER;";
    $selector = "";
    echo isset($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_REPEAT;" : "EMPTY_GUARD_AGAIN;";
    return true;
});
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
restore_error_handler();
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo $selector === "" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
$reader = null;
echo "DONE;";
